posts.description: We had a great day at Battle Abbey today for the annual re-enactment of the Battle of Hastings . I thought the Saxons looked pretty sharp to be fair, so it was something of surprise to see them so roundly beat by the Normans. There’s always next year, lads. The summer holidays flew by in something of a blur. It was a change of routine for all of us. The kids spent several weeks at a (very affordable, open 8-6, thank you!) holiday club near Belsize Park. They love it there and come home every day tired and filthy. A- and I were busy with work most of the summer too, so the days were long and hot. We did take a week off in Barcelona .
